title: Projecting enrollment with enrollcast
text: cohort survival / grade progression ratio method projects enrollment asking: students grade g year, many appear grade g+1 next year? ratio captures net retention, migration, repetition. enrollcast estimates ratios history applies forward matrix projection.

title: Projecting enrollment with enrollcast
text: ratios sit sub-diagonal projection matrix; entry-grade row zero entry supplied exogenously.
code: ratios <- progression_ratios(history, method = "mean") ratios #>   grade_from grade_to     ratio #> 1          K        1 0.9250000 #> 2          1        2 0.9678363 projection_matrix(ratios) #>       K         1 2 #> K 0.000 0.0000000 0 #> 1 0.925 0.0000000 0 #> 2 0.000 0.9678363 0

title: Projecting enrollment with enrollcast
text: entry grade (kindergarten ) feeder grade, supply future values — example birth-cohort housing model.
code: base <- history[history$year == 2023, c("grade", "enrollment")] projection <- project_enrollment(   base = base,   ratios = ratios,   horizon = 3,   entry = c(125, 130, 128),   start_year = 2023 ) projection #>   year grade enrollment #> 1 2024     K  125.00000 #> 2 2024     1  111.00000 #> 3 2024     2   95.81579 #> 4 2025     K  130.00000 #> 5 2025     1  115.62500 #> 6 2025     2  107.42982 #> 7 2026     K  128.00000 #> 8 2026     1  120.25000 #> 9 2026     2  111.90607

title: Projecting enrollment with enrollcast
text: project_enrollment() returns projected years . Combine history plotting:
code: observed <- data.frame(   year = history$year,   grade = as.character(history$grade),   enrollment = history$enrollment ) combined <- rbind(observed, projection) head(combined) #>   year grade enrollment #> 1 2021     K        100 #> 2 2021     1         90 #> 3 2021     2         80 #> 4 2022     K        110 #> 5 2022     1         95 #> 6 2022     2         88

what: Project School Enrollment with Grade Progression Ratios
title: Project School Enrollment with Grade Progression Ratios
text: enrollcast projects school enrollment using cohort survival / grade progression ratio method, implemented matrix projection. works level aggregation (school, district, LEA, city-wide) number grades, operates single grade--year enrollment series.

title: Project School Enrollment with Grade Progression Ratios
Project School Enrollment with Grade Progression Ratios
text: Inspect underlying projection matrix time:
code: library(enrollcast)  # Historical grade-level enrollment (long format). history <- data.frame(   year = rep(2021:2023, each = 3),   grade = factor(rep(c("K", "1", "2"), 3), levels = c("K", "1", "2")),   enrollment = c(100, 90, 80, 110, 95, 88, 120, 99, 91) )  # 1. Calculate progression ratios. ratios <- progression_ratios(history, method = "mean") ratios  # 2. Project forward. The entry grade (K) is supplied exogenously. base <- history[history$year == 2023, c("grade", "enrollment")] projection <- project_enrollment(   base       = base,   ratios     = ratios,   horizon    = 3,   entry      = c(125, 130, 128),   start_year = 2023 ) projection projection_matrix(ratios)

title: Project School Enrollment with Grade Progression Ratios
text: enrollcast projects one series per call. project many schools LEAs, split map:
code: projections <- lapply(split(history, history$school), function(df) {   ratios <- progression_ratios(df)   base <- df[df$year == max(df$year), c("grade", "enrollment")]   project_enrollment(base, ratios, horizon = 3, entry = rep(100, 3)) })

title: Compute grade progression ratios — progression_ratios
text: Calculates cohort survival / grade progression ratios historical grade-level enrollment. non-entry grade, ratio enrollment grade divided enrollment grade one year earlier, summarised across available year--year transitions.

title: Compute grade progression ratios — progression_ratios
code: progression_ratios(   data,   year = "year",   grade = "grade",   enrollment = "enrollment",   method = c("mean", "geometric", "median", "last", "weighted"),   n_years = NULL,   weights = NULL,   grade_order = NULL )

title: Compute grade progression ratios — progression_ratios
text: data long data frame historical enrollment one row per grade per year. year, grade, enrollment Column names data (character scalars). Defaults "year", "grade", "enrollment". method summarise per-year ratios one ratio per grade: "mean" (default), "geometric", "median", "last" (recent transition ), "weighted". n_years Optional. Use recent n_years transitions. n_years exceeds number available transitions, used. weights method = "weighted", numeric vector aligned -recent oldest, one weight per transition year used. grade_order Optional character vector giving low--high grade order. omitted, factor levels, numeric ordering, (warning) alphabetical ordering used.

title: Compute grade progression ratios — progression_ratios
text: data frame columns grade_from, grade_to, ratio, one row per non-entry grade.

title: Compute grade progression ratios — progression_ratios
code: history <- data.frame(   year = rep(2021:2023, each = 3),   grade = factor(rep(c("K", "1", "2"), 3), levels = c("K", "1", "2")),   enrollment = c(100, 90, 80, 110, 95, 88, 120, 99, 91) ) progression_ratios(history) #>   grade_from grade_to     ratio #> 1          K        1 0.9250000 #> 2          1        2 0.9678363

title: Project enrollment forward — project_enrollment
text: Projects grade-level enrollment forward arbitrary horizon using grade progression ratio method. Internally builds projection matrix ratios advances enrollment one year time (one matrix-vector product per projected year), overwriting entry grade supplied exogenous value year.

title: Project enrollment forward — project_enrollment
code: project_enrollment(   base,   ratios = NULL,   horizon = NULL,   entry = NULL,   schedule = NULL,   start_year = NULL )

title: Project enrollment forward — project_enrollment
text: base recent observed enrollment: either data frame columns grade enrollment (optionally year), named numeric vector (names grades). ratios data frame progression ratios progression_ratios(). Optional schedule supplied. horizon Number years project (positive integer). entry Exogenous entry-grade enrollment projected year: numeric vector length horizon, data frame enrollment value column. NULL, entry grade held constant base value warning issued. schedule Optional prebuilt projection schedule: list per-year steps, list(matrix = <square projection matrix>, entry = <NULL single number>), produced swing_schedule(). supplied, ratios entry must NULL horizon defaults schedule length. Step matrices must share identical grade dimnames, determine grade order base aligned . start_year Optional integer label base year; output years run start_year + 1. NULL, derived year column base present, otherwise output years 1..horizon.

title: Project enrollment forward — project_enrollment
text: long data frame columns year, grade, enrollment, covering projected years .

title: Project enrollment forward — project_enrollment
code: history <- data.frame(   year = rep(2021:2023, each = 3),   grade = factor(rep(c("K", "1", "2"), 3), levels = c("K", "1", "2")),   enrollment = c(100, 90, 80, 110, 95, 88, 120, 99, 91) ) ratios <- progression_ratios(history) base <- subset(history, year == 2023, c("grade", "enrollment")) project_enrollment(base, ratios,   horizon = 3, entry = c(125, 130, 128),   start_year = 2023 ) #>   year grade enrollment #> 1 2024     K  125.00000 #> 2 2024     1  111.00000 #> 3 2024     2   95.81579 #> 4 2025     K  130.00000 #> 5 2025     1  115.62500 #> 6 2025     2  107.42982 #> 7 2026     K  128.00000 #> 8 2026     1  120.25000 #> 9 2026     2  111.90607

title: Build the projection matrix — projection_matrix
text: Assembles projection matrix used advance enrollment. Progression ratios placed sub-diagonal (non-entry grade fed grade ); entry-grade row left zero entry enrollment supplied exogenously project_enrollment().

title: Build the projection matrix — projection_matrix
text: ratios data frame columns grade_from, grade_to, ratio, returned progression_ratios(). grade_order Optional character vector giving low--high grade order. omitted, order reconstructed transition chain. Every non-entry grade grade_order must appear grade_to ratios.

title: Build the projection matrix — projection_matrix
text: square numeric matrix grade dimnames.

title: Build the projection matrix — projection_matrix
code: ratios <- data.frame(   grade_from = c("K", "1"),   grade_to = c("1", "2"),   ratio = c(0.92, 0.97) ) projection_matrix(ratios) #>      K    1 2 #> K 0.00 0.00 0 #> 1 0.92 0.00 0 #> 2 0.00 0.97 0

what: Build a swing/recovery projection schedule — swing_schedule
title: Build a swing/recovery projection schedule — swing_schedule
text: Assembles per-year project_enrollment() schedule school passing temporary relocation ("swing"): enrollment held flat depressed observed level swing (identity steps), scaled year--year recovery multipliers recovery window (diagonal steps), projected grade progression ratio method (normal projection matrix) remaining years.

title: Build a swing/recovery projection schedule — swing_schedule
code: swing_schedule(   ratios,   horizon,   swing_years,   recovery,   entry = NULL,   grade_order = NULL )

title: Build a swing/recovery projection schedule — swing_schedule
text: ratios data frame progression ratios progression_ratios(). horizon Number years project (positive integer). swing_years Number leading years school swinging (non-negative integer); enrollment held flat base. recovery Recovery multipliers applied one year , immediately swing compounding prior year: numeric vector (whole-school, one multiplier per recovery year) grade--year numeric matrix (one row per grade). Use numeric(0) recovery window. entry Exogenous entry-grade enrollment normal (GPR) years — horizon - swing_years - length(recovery) years recovery. Must empty normal years. grade_order Optional low--high grade order, passed projection_matrix().

title: Build a swing/recovery projection schedule — swing_schedule
text: list horizon projection steps suitable schedule argument project_enrollment().

title: Build a swing/recovery projection schedule — swing_schedule
enrollcast 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development version. progression_ratios() computes grade progression ratios historical grade-level enrollment, configurable averaging (mean, geometric, median, last, weighted). projection_matrix() assembles projection matrix progression ratios. project_enrollment() projects enrollment forward arbitrary horizon, taking entry grade exogenously. project_enrollment() accepts prebuilt per-year schedule projection steps alternative ratios/horizon/entry arguments. swing_schedule() builds swing/recovery projection schedule school passing temporary relocation.
